## Result

Proves positive recurrence for every fixed real λ > 0 for the exact deterministic-first-chunk six-rate continuous-time Markov chain in TURN_4.md, with denominator x+y+1 and the permanent seed retained. Claimed solved after **4/5 substantive author turns**.

The global Foster function joins workload and rounded cohort imbalance with finite Poisson corrections and monotone ratio cutoffs. First-download interface errors are nonpositive; remaining interface errors are explicitly controlled. No sector-switching or stationary-mean gap is left.

## Independent validation

- Independent full adversarial review: **PASS**, no mandatory mathematical revisions
- Author controls: 71,165 exact rational assertions across 5,200 states
- Independent backward-corrector implementation: 36,709 assertions across 1,908 states at three different noninteger loads
- Both receipts reproduced byte-for-byte; 72 package/manifest checks passed; Python syntax checks passed
- Frozen proof and review bytes preserved; portable reviewer copy changes exactly one proof-path literal

## Source qualifications

The target is the deterministic-first-chunk model, not Enforced Friedman. OWR 48/2010 printed p. 2782 states the stability conjecture; arXiv:0910.5577v1 Figure 2 confirms the exact six rates, but its opposite historical conjecture is superseded. The 2011 HAL author-proof details are inherited from the pinned source audit because fresh HAL/PDF screenshots were unavailable. Standard birth–death/Poisson/Foster tools are credited. Historical priority and worldwide novelty are not certified.

## Scope of changes

Forty files under attempts/30001608 preserve all prior turns and add the accepted proof/review package. QUEUE.md changes only target 30001608 from queued 0/5 to claimed_solved 4/5. Built on fresh main 3fef16e1d507b2a429d35da3c8681b386530007f with WIP checkpoint fdfc1de61e7a912219a07445cdf1d247c1cef88b retained as second parent. No queue regeneration, merge, release, or unrelated changes.

Entry point: [RESULT_ACCEPTED.md](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/1198534928f4c2bf8bf758c9ceb16edaa3a496e8/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30001608/RESULT_ACCEPTED.md). Proof hash: `34e043b456ddc25cc37d86d3e5a39d10243de91c6a5d5002952252d2eab1b0fa`. Review hash: `8e1564a4d51e0cf31aaac3cfc0a43daa1f3fb83d6a369ecb2ed66ea20016aab0`.
